title: Copilot component manifest
description: Copilot components are loaded by Copilot via the SPFx MCP server and rendered in an iframe. Unlike web parts and ACEs, they do not persist on a page canvas.

experimentalData.title: Experimental property bag
experimentalData.description: Only use for properties not ready for production.

capabilities.title: Component Capabilities
capabilities.description: Capabilities declared by a Copilot Component. availableDisplayModes and tools mirror MCP Apps capabilities; defaultDisplayMode is an SPFx startup preference resolved after ui/initialize.

availableDisplayModes.title: Available Display Modes
availableDisplayModes.description: Display modes this component supports. The host uses this to decide which UI affordances to surface (e.g. an expand button for fullscreen).

defaultDisplayMode.title: Default Display Mode
defaultDisplayMode.description: SPFx startup preference. If 'fullscreen' is selectable, SPFx requests it once per logical component invocation after ui/initialize and uses the mode the host grants; otherwise the component stays inline. Values not in availableDisplayModes are ignored.

tools.title: Tool Provider Capabilities
tools.description: Declares that the component exposes MCP-style tools the host can call back into it.

listChanged.description: Whether the component supports tools/list_changed notifications.

tools.title: Tool Definitions
tools.description: Each entry is a distinct MCP tool backed by this component. The MCP server emits one tool per entry in list_tools; tool/call routes by name to the same component class with the matching tool's validated arguments.

name.title: Tool Name
name.description: The MCP tool name used in list_tools / tool/call. Must be a valid identifier: start with a letter or underscore, then letters/digits/underscores only.

description.title: Tool Description
description.description: LLM-friendly description of when to use this tool. Exposed as the description in the MCP tool definition.

propertiesSchema.title: Properties Schema
propertiesSchema.description: A JSON Schema (draft-07) defining the properties needed to render the component for this tool, or a build-time reference with an id field.

then.description: Reference to a properties schema export, resolved at build time.

id.description: The identifier for the properties schema reference.

else.description: An inline JSON Schema (draft-07) object defining the component properties.
